'''Xantus''' was a [[General/Legends|general]] who commanded the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. A lifelong military man, Xantus took orders from the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence Service]], though the planet's [[Planetary Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Ellor Orgraal]] believed that he controlled Xantus and the military force on Ord Radama.<ref name="OaA1" />
